data.long_meaning: Arnelle is derived from the Old French name Arnaut, which means 'eagle power' or 'soldier'. In Christian tradition, the name is associated with strength, courage, and the eagle's majestic flight, symbolizing the spiritual ascent towards divine wisdom. The name Arnelle carries the meaning “Eagle's strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arnelle usually hope their child will grow to embody eagle's strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Αρνέλλη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Arnelle in Greek is ‘Αρνέλλη’ (Arnelle). It is derived from the Greek words ‘αρν’ (arn) which means mountain, and ‘ελλη’ (elle) which means Goddess. This name also means ‘Mountain of Goddess’ or ‘Mountain of God’ in the Greek language.

in_latin.name: Arnella
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Arnelle in Latin is ‘Arnella’. It is derived from the Latin words ‘araneus’ which means mountain, and ‘deus’ which means God. Therefore, the name Arnelle in Latin can be translated as ‘Mountain of God’.

in_english.name: Arnelle
in_english.long_meaning: The name Arnelle in English is derived from the Old English words ‘eoran’ (earn) which means mountain, and ‘god’ which means God. Therefore, the name Arnelle in English can be translated as ‘Mountain of God’.
